title: London vs Amsterdam: Which Should You Visit?
verdict: London for depth and free museums; Amsterdam for charm and ease. Do both via Eurostar if you have 7+ days.

categories.name: Museums & Culture
categories.summary: London's free world-class museums give it a decisive edge.

categories.name: Nightlife
categories.summary: Amsterdam's party atmosphere and iconic RLD beats London's variety.

categories.name: Food & Dining
categories.summary: London for fine dining diversity, Amsterdam for affordable local specialties.

categories.name: Transit
categories.summary: Walkable + bikeable; London requires the Tube.

categories.name: Day Trips
categories.summary: Bath, Cotswolds, Stonehenge, Cambridge/Oxford — world-class options.

faq.question: Which is better for first-time visitors?
faq.answer: Amsterdam is easier for a short trip; London rewards a longer stay.

faq.question: How far apart?
faq.answer: 450km. Eurostar takes 4-4.5 hours from St Pancras to Centraal.

faq.question: Better nightlife?
faq.answer: Amsterdam for party atmosphere; London for cocktail culture and theater.
